subject: act-tr
title: ACT.TR.------COSP.
description: Chart on book p. 151 (UPB(II)-13). ACT-TR (actual transformation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; COS-P (cosmic particulars) (the title writes COSP) is the partner. SPI-AN is on a dashed line from the subject. From SPI-AN: AFI (affinity insight). RE-ST (restructuralism) is on a dashed line from AFI. PHY-U-C (physical universe context) is on a dashed line from COS-P. From PHY-U-C: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and POL-DYM (political dynamics). SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars) is on a dashed line from POL-DYM. From POL-DYM: POL-CON (political consciousness). From POL-CON: RT-DY (reality dynamics).
